| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Window size** `size` | 3 | 3 to 25, odd px | Width and height of the square window. |
| **Choose by** `by` | Rank | Rank, Percentile | Give the position in the sorted window as a rank number or as a percentile. |
| **Rank** `rank` | 5 | 1 to 625 | Used when Choose by is Rank. Position in the sorted window, from 1 (the smallest) to the number of values. Larger ranks are lowered to the last one. |
| **Percentile** `percentile` | 50 | 0 to 100 % | Used when Choose by is Percentile. Position in the sorted window as a percentage. 0 picks the smallest value and 100 the largest. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
